other_conditions: Applicant must be a bonafide resident of Himachal Pradesh
Must have secured at least 60% marks in the Himachal Pradesh Board of School Education Class 12 examination in any stream (Arts, Science, Commerce)
Must have secured at least 60% marks in the undergraduate degree examination from a recognized university
Must be enrolled in an academic or professional stream at a recognized university or institution within or outside Himachal Pradesh
benefits_summary: ₹18,000 per annum scholarship awarded to up to 150 meritorious students based on merit.
